statement: At the pinned Linux commit, Joy-Con 2 firmware types left 0x00 and right 0x01 select input report 0x07 and 0x08 respectively, while unified report 0x05 is also parsed. The per-half reports use button data starting at offset 3 and one packed 12-bit stick at offsets 6 through 8; the unified path uses different offsets and side-specific mappings. These are Linux decoder expectations, not measured retail packets.

applicability.scope: Nintendo Switch 2 Linux input report format and decoding
